scope: A visit to a surface that claims to be canon-governed. The watermark is a claim. Facts keep their evidence class.
owns: a visit report of facts, each with an evidence class
does: Stamp every fact with tested, documented, observed, or design.
Refuse to mark a design or documented fact as established.
doesNot: Treat a missing marker as proof the surface conforms.
Upgrade a design claim because the persona file exists.

claims.text: A fact with evidence design or documented and established true fails. An empty fact list fails.
An absent watermark means the surface conforms.
claims.where: Not true. The runtime checker still passes a surface with no marker. This persona does not treat that gap as conformance.
